title: Anaplan, Inc. (NYSE:PLAN) Just Reported, And Analysts Assigned A US$53.72 Price Target
主要内容: Anaplan, Inc. (NYSE:PLAN) shares fell 21% in the week following its latest annual results, closing at US$28.39. Revenues reached US$348m, matching forecasts, while the company reported a statutory loss of US$1.15 per share, in line with expectations. Analysts revised their forecasts after the April 2, 2020, earnings report, with the average price target dropping 5.2% to US$53.72. Revenue expectations for 2021 were adjusted from US$464.2m to US$459.1m, reflecting a 32% year-over-year sales growth. Per-share losses are projected to rise to US$1.20, aligning with prior estimates. Analysts forecast 32% revenue growth for 2021, higher than the 12% forecast for similar companies. Price targets range from US$35.00 to US$71.00, showing varied analyst expectations. Analysts reconfirmed loss per share and revenue estimates, indicating sales are tracking in line with expectations. However, price targets were cut, reflecting greater pessimism about the company's intrinsic value. The report highlights potential warning signs, including two concerning factors.
